# Third-party wallpapers - credits and licence status

**These images are other people's artwork. Their licences have not been verified** and they are not covered
by surfd's MIT / CC BY-SA 4.0 licences (see `LICENSES/LicenseRef-third-party-unverified.txt`). They are here
so the wallpaper features can be tested. Confirm each licence before shipping them in an ISO or
redistributing. If you own one and want it removed or credited differently, open an issue.

Names come from the file names the maintainer supplied, not from verified sources.
